content.title: experiments with rice
content.account: An ongoing exploration of rice as a tangible interface, a way to represent information, and a potential computational material. The project begins with a familiar food and asks how its material properties and cultural meanings might shape interactions with computation.

content.title: Prāsa
content.summary: What happens when poetic rules become programming rules?
content.account: Prāsa is an experimental programming language informed by chandassu, a system of Telugu poetic metre. It explores how rhythm, syllabic patterns, and positional constraints can shape computational expression.

citations.annotation: Dhulipalla describes Prāsa and its use of Telugu metrical and positional constraints. This connection documents the project rather than establishing a general claim about all Telugu cultural knowledge.
